name: Vaelith
bio: Vaelith trained her whole life for the Green Laurel Tournament – the world’s premier archery competition. When she won the highest honors, she thought her journey was done… until Malkanis conscripted her. No matter. Her drive to exceed has not diminished, even on the battlefield.
